answer.justification: Output-level measurements match the reference exactly. Exact-match rate is 1.000, median first divergence is 64 and edit distance is 0.000. Refusals, disclaimers, stage directions, short replies and mean length (59.9) are identical to the reference's, with 0 refusals added or dropped. Quantized models show an exact-match rate of 0.016–0.031 and edit distance of 0.52–0.57. Fine-tuned models show 0.56–0.65 and system-prompted models 0.79–0.82.
